name: Hall of Arms
summary: In Ironforge’s Military Ward, the Hall of Arms readies the city’s forces for battle. Command staff oversee the troops while warriors and hunters train, and machines are prepared for war.

sections.title: Heart of the Mountain's Arsenal
sections.body: The Hall of Arms commands Ironforge’s armed forces from the Military Ward’s southeastern corner. Veteran instructors train warriors and hunters there, while the facility stores and stages machines of war. Steam tanks are assembled and maintained for Alliance battlefields. Gyrocopters and flying machines ride industrial conveyor belts through shafts in the cavern ceiling, then launch toward the Ironforge Airfield above.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Arms?
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms commands Ironforge’s military forces. It trains warriors and hunters and stores, maintains, and deploys war machines such as steam tanks and gyrocopters.

faq.q: Where do the flying machines launched from the ceiling go?
faq.answer: Conveyor systems carry flying machines through shafts in the ceiling to the Ironforge Airfield on the mountain slopes above. This chimney is one of the only direct exits from the mountain besides the main gates.

faq.q: Who can I find training inside the Hall?
faq.answer: Warrior and hunter instructors train inside the Hall of Arms. Alliance battlemasters also organize troop movements and enlistments for battlefronts across the continent.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Arms located?
aliases: how to get to hall of arms
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms stands at the back of Ironforge’s Military Ward, in the city’s southeastern quadrant.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Khaz Modan’s union of martial discipline and mechanical ingenuity in the Hall of Arms. Tanks and aerial squadrons protect the mountain kingdom.
As a warrior, you can find dwarven armsmen and veterans at the Hall of Arms for instruction and battlemaster leadership.
